steps.title: Write the spec
steps.prompt: Read this repository. Write spec.md in {{run.dir}} for: {{inputs.idea}}. Sections: goal, non-goals, user-visible behaviour, acceptance checks. Do not edit the repository. Give the work a short pull request title.

steps.title: Approve the spec
steps.gate_summary: Read {{run.dir}}/spec.md. Approve to build it, reject to stop.

steps.title: Build it on a new branch
steps.prompt: Build what {{run.dir}}/spec.md describes in this worktree. Write a failing test first, then the code, then run the tests. Commit your work on the current branch. Do not push.

steps.title: Approve opening the pull request
steps.gate_summary: Open a pull request on {{inputs.repo}} from {{steps.build.outputs.branch}} into {{inputs.base_branch}}. Tests passed: {{steps.verify.outputs.passed}}.

steps.title: Push and open the pull request
